v2_vs_v3.reading: 39 tier-1 finals of fresh form moved probabilities by a mean of 0.45pp and flipped exactly one coin-flip side. Late-August team form is a WEAK input to V13 at this sample size — consistent with the standing finding that V13's binding constraint is discrimination, not data recency. The spread barely moved (SD 1.58 -> 1.61pp), so under the standing spread diagnostic form freshness did NOT touch the binding constraint.

v1_vs_v2.reading: starter resolution moved probabilities 5.6x more than form freshness (2.54pp vs 0.45pp) and flipped four sides. Pitcher identity dominates team form in this engine — the sharpest quantitative statement the program has made about where V13's information actually comes from, and it aligns with the personnel-layer roadmap priority.
